specs.title: Booking link and QR generation
specs.why: Merchants convert walk-in traffic by displaying a scannable link in the shop.
specs.scope: Generate a branded booking URL and a downloadable QR image and PDF.
acceptance: The generated code resolves to `/{slug}`, verified by `pnpm test`
`app/api/qr/[slug]/route.ts` returns HTTP 200 with a PDF body
The owner receives the file over WhatsApp after setup

specs.title: No-show tracking
specs.why: No-show data is the input to risk scoring and deposit gating.
specs.scope: Owner marks bookings as no-show from the dashboard or by replying to the WhatsApp notification.
tasks: Add `prisma/schema.prisma`: add no-show counters to the `Client` model
acceptance: Both surfaces set status `no_show`, verified by `pnpm test`
The counters on `Client` increment once per marking
Marking a future booking returns HTTP 400
